question: Who is the author of the book 'My Master'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swami Vivekananda.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Swami Vivekananda**__

 __
 
• **​**__Swami Vivekananda addressed the World Parliament of Religions in Chicago in 1893.
 
• Swami Vivekananda's original name was Narendranath Datta.
 
• Swami Vivekananda was a chief disciple of the 19th-century Indian mystic Sri Ramakrishna Paramahamsa.
 
• Swami Vivekananda was the founder of Ramakrishna Mission (1897) and Ramakrishna Math.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore**__

 __
 
• He was popularly known as '**Gurudev'.**
 
• He wrote the national anthems of two countries, India and Bangladesh.
 
 
 
• **Raja Ram Mohan Roy**__
 __
 
• Raja Ram Mohan Roy the founder of the Brahmo Samaj.
 
• He was a great scholar and an independent thinker.
 
• He is known as the 'Father of Modern India' or 'Father of the Bengal Renaissance.
 
 
 
• **Sri Aurobindo**__
 
 
• Sri Aurobindo was an **Indian philosopher, yoga guru, maharishi, poet, and Indian nationalist.**
 
• He was also a journalist, editing newspapers like** Bande Mataram.**
